articles.title: US Envoys Shuttle Between Kyiv and Moscow in Push for Peace
articles.summary: Top US envoys met Zelensky in Kyiv after talks with Putin. They're pushing for a deal to end the war. Both sides agreed to pause strikes on capitals for 3 days. Will it work?

articles.title: Halal Barbecue Is Taking Over Texas, One Brisket at a Time
articles.summary: Texas BBQ is getting a halal makeover. Muslim pitmasters are adding their own twists, from Pakistani spices to Iraqi sausage. At least a dozen spots now serve halal meats. It's a new tradition.

articles.title: Debut Dream: Maitland-Niles' 30-Yard Stunner Rescues Everton
articles.summary: With the last kick of the match, Ainsley Maitland-Niles smashed a 30-yard equalizer on his debut to snatch a 2-2 draw for Everton against Manchester United. The dramatic finish kept Everton unbeaten.
